question: What is the arithmetic mean of the observations 42, 29, 42, 58, 18, 39, 41, 79 and 93?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum = 42 + 29 + 42 + 58 + 18 + 39 + 41 + 79 + 93 = 441

Total numbers = 9

Mean = 441 ÷ 9 = 49

**∴ Answer = 49**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations = 42, 29, 42, 58, 18, 39, 41, 79, 93

**Formula used:**

Mean = (Sum of observations) ÷ (Number of observations)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Sum = 42 + 29 + 42 + 58 + 18 + 39 + 41 + 79 + 93

⇒ = 441

⇒ Number of observations = 9

⇒ Mean = 441 ÷ 9

⇒ = 49

**∴ The correct answer is 49.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean

Mean = Total sum ÷ Number of values

Quick Tip

Group numbers to simplify addition

Usefulness

Mean represents central tendency
